niche_preference_profile: Prefers clean, structured interfaces with clear hierarchy, spacious card-based organization, rounded refined components, and restrained visual treatment. Generally favors minimal clutter, integrated/flat presentation over raised or decorative containers, and clear readable emphasis. Color preference is mixed by context, but consistently rejects harsh high-intensity palettes and prefers more cohesive, controlled color usage with soft accents or dark themes paired with light cards. Likes strong CTA emphasis when action clarity matters, but otherwise prefers muted, integrated controls and a single clear primary action.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers organized card-based layouts with clear hierarchy, distinct grouping, and easy-to-scan section structure.
Prefers simpler compositions with fewer decorative elements, less helper copy, and reduced visual noise.
Prefers breathable spacing, stronger separation between elements, and balanced proportions rather than dense packing or oversized elements.
Prefers polished UI components with rounded cards/fields, subtle borders, and softer contained icon treatments.
Prefers flat, background-integrated elements with little or no shadow instead of floating, raised, or modal-like containers.
Prefers cohesive color systems with neutral or dark foundations and softer, controlled accents rather than harsh, electric, or tonally inconsistent color treatments.
Prefers actions to have clear hierarchy: strong contrast for the main CTA when needed, soft-button treatment for secondary actions, and avoidance of competing primary actions.
